name: 16-type personality fortune
summary: For entertainment; not advice. From a four-letter personality type code and an age: a sample birth date drawn from that age, its Korean lunar date, Western Sun sign and three saju pillars, and today's reading that blends them with the four letters by fixed rules (our own mapping for fun). The birth date is a sample drawn from your age, not your real birthday. MBTI is a trademark of The Myers-Briggs Company; not affiliated.

mbti.description: a four-letter 16-type code such as INTJ (-A or -T is ignored)

input_help: mbti: a four-letter type code (e.g. INTJ); age: full years 0-110; today defaults to today in Asia/Seoul. The birth date is a sample drawn from your age, not your real birthday.

rules: profile first: the sample birth date makes the given age today (today - (age+1) years < date <= today - age years) and is drawn by the contract's seed rule, so the same input on the same day gives the same date and words

calendar, western and saju read the sample date (no hour: three pillars); synthesis blends them with the four letters by the mbti-fortune agent's fixed rule table (our own mapping for fun); no model writes it

every answer starts with 'For entertainment; not advice.', says the birth date is a sample, names the trademark holder, and never states or advises on health, money, legal or medical matters, nor uses frightening words
only the type and the age are received; the raw input never reaches logs, the ledger, evidence or cache keys

demand: A direct user request (11-17). Measured: external asks 0 in 30 days (Explore queries are not stored as text and cannot be counted), catalog supply 9 (no x402); public interest: the four-letter types as a common language among Gen Z in Korea and Japan (Korea Times 2026-04, The Star 2025-10-10) (growth team, 11-17).
